title: Dear Santa Define Good Mug, Funny Christmas Coffee Mug, Secret Santa Gift, Naughty List Mug, Coworker Christmas Gift
description:
Define "good"... A cheeky Christmas mug for anyone who's not entirely sure they made the nice list. Hand-lettered "DEAR SANTA, DEFINE 'GOOD'" in festive red and green with a little Santa hat and golden sparkles.

A fun Secret Santa, office exchange or stocking stuffer gift for friends, coworkers and family.

DETAILS
- White glossy ceramic mug
- Two sizes: 330 ml (11 oz) or 440 ml (15 oz)
- Printed on both sides: the design shows whether you hold the mug in your right or left hand
- Dishwasher and microwave safe

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the EU (Czech Republic) and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships within Europe and the UK.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
